text:
mike: spotted a service account payload dumped into logs for a partner job. S3: s3://staging-archive/partner-job/2026-04-07/output.log.gz :warning:

anya: can you paste a redacted snippet to INC-2026-121? we need the private_key_id to revoke quickly.

mike: pasted. private_key_id: z9y8x7w6v5. email: partner-staging@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

riley: treating as confirmed exposure. immediate plan: 1) revoke key, 2) create new SA key with minimal roles, 3) rotate Vault entries and k8s secret references, 4) sweep archives. I'll run the revoke now.

riley: revoke cmd: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete z9y8x7w6v5 --iam-account=partner-staging@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — success.

riley: created new key, uploaded to Vault path `secret/staging/sa/partner-staging`. PR to infra: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1310

anya: enable Vault audit device on staging mount if not on. Also schedule rewrap for any S3 objects that had the blob. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cred-rotation#rewrap

sec-bot: Checklist added to INC-2026-121: [revoke, rotate-vault, rewrap-archives, rb-constraint, evidence-archive].

mike: started grep-sweep job sweep-2026-04-07-2 for last 120 days. will post matches in the ticket.

anya: temporary RBAC change: remove `roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` from devs for staging project for 36h. Riley, can you apply?

riley: done. applied policy and created TASK-2026-250 to track rollback.

mike: sweep found two other older logs containing similar blobs. creating subtasks and marking them for rewrap+rotation.

anya: postmortem scheduled T+24h. add all command logs and evidence to the incident. keep S3 objects read-only for auditors.

riley: follow-up: propose an automated detector for SA JSON patterns in logs and an alert that auto-creates an incident. I'll prototype and attach TASK-2026-251.

mike: thanks team, closing thread update.
